steps.t: be 動詞就是「是」：說身分、狀態、在哪裡時不能少了它
steps.p: 中文可以說「我很累」，英文不能說 I tired，中間一定要放 am／is／are。

ex.en: I am tired.
She is a nurse.

steps.t: 看主詞決定用哪一個
steps.p: I 只配 am；he、she、it 和「一個人、一個東西」配 is；you、we、they 和「兩個以上」配 are。

ex.en: The patient is awake.
The patients are awake.

steps.t: 否定加 not，問句把 be 動詞搬到最前面
steps.p: 否定：be 動詞後面加 not（is not = isn't、are not = aren't）。問句：把 am／is／are 搬到主詞前面，回答用 Yes, he is.／No, he isn't.

ex.en: He is not hungry.
Is he hungry?

mistakes.why: 這裡要用 am 把主詞 I 和描述狀態的 tired 接起來。tired 是形容詞，不能自己當這句話的動詞。
she 是單數，配 is。

drills.q: My mother ___ a teacher.
drills.why: my mother 是一個人（單數），配 is。

drills.q: We ___ nursing students.
drills.why: we 是兩個人以上，配 are。

drills.q: I ___ (be) from Taiwan.
drills.why: I 只配 am。

drills.q: ___ the doctor busy?
drills.why: 問句把 be 動詞搬到前面；the doctor 是單數，用 Is。

drills.q: The students ___ (be，否定) late.
drills.why: students 是複數，配 are；否定在後面加 not。

drills.q: He am my friend.
drills.why: he 配 is，am 只給 I 用。

drills.q: You is very kind.
drills.why: you 不管是一個人還是很多人，都配 are。

steps.t: 名詞前面放 my、your、his、her……，說是誰的
steps.p: I → my（我的）、you → your（你的）、he → his（他的）、she → her（她的）、it → its（它的）、we → our（我們的）、they → their（他們的）。後面一定要接名詞。

ex.en: My mother is a nurse.
Her brother is a doctor.

steps.t: its 是「它的」，it's 可以是 it is 或 it has
steps.p: its 沒有一撇，接名詞表示「它的」。有一撇的 it's 要看後面的字，在 It's cold 裡是 it is，在 It's been cold 裡是 it has。their（他們的）和 there（那裡）、they're（they are）也要分清楚。

ex.en: Our teacher is kind.
Their room is small.
The cat is in its bed.
It's cold today.
ex.zh: 今天很冷。這裡的 It's 是 It is。

ex.en: It's been a long day.
ex.zh: 今天過得很漫長。這裡的 It's 是 It has。

drills.q: ___ name is Amy. I am a student.
drills.why: 名詞 name 前面說「我的」用 my。

drills.q: Tom and Sam are brothers. ___ father is a doctor.
drills.why: 說「他們的」用 their；they 是「他們」，there 是「那裡」。

drills.q: She is a nurse. ___ (她的) patients are kind.
drills.why: 說「她的」用 her，後面接名詞 patients。

drills.q: He is my friend. He name is Leo.
accept: He is my friend. His name is Leo.
drills.why: 名詞 name 前面要用 his（他的），不是 he（他）。

drills.q: ___ been a long day.
drills.why: It's been 是 It has been 的縮寫，句中需要 has。its 只表示「它的」。

steps.t: 只有一個：前面要有 a 或 an
steps.p: 可數名詞只有一個的時候，前面要加 a 或 an（前面已經有 this、my、the 這種字時就不用，例如 my pen、the apple）。看下一個字「開頭的發音」：母音（a、e、i、o、u 的音）用 an，其他用 a。

ex.en: I have a pen.
She eats an apple.

steps.t: 看的是發音，不是字母
steps.p: hour 的 h 不發音，聽起來是母音開頭，所以是 an hour；uniform 開頭唸「you」，是子音，所以是 a uniform。

ex.en: Please wait an hour.
He wears a uniform.

steps.t: 兩個以上：字尾加 s 或 es
steps.p: 大部分加 -s；字尾是 s、x、ch、sh 加 -es；子音 + y 把 y 改成 ies；有些不規則要背。兩個以上就不能再用 a／an。

ex.en: Two nurses are here.
The children are asleep.

mistakes.why: 一個人的職業前面要加 a 或 an。
child 的複數是不規則的 children。

drills.q: He is ___ engineer.
drills.why: engineer 開頭是母音的音，用 an。

drills.q: I need three ___.
drills.why: three 是三個，名詞要用複數 masks。

drills.q: My sister has two ___ (baby).
drills.why: 子音 + y 結尾，把 y 改成 ies。

drills.q: Please wait ___ hour.
drills.why: hour 的 h 不發音，開頭是母音的音，用 an。

drills.q: My ___ (foot) hurt.
drills.why: foot 的複數是 feet。

drills.q: This is a orange.
drills.why: orange 開頭是母音的音，用 an。

drills.q: She has three watch.
drills.why: three 後面要用複數；ch 結尾加 -es。

steps.t: 人或名詞後面加 's，表示「誰的」
steps.p: Amy's bag 是「Amy 的包包」，my mother's room 是「我媽媽的房間」。's 放在「擁有的人」後面，東西放在後面。

ex.en: Tom's sister is a nurse.
The doctor's car is red.
ex.zh: 那位醫師的車是紅色的。

steps.t: 已經有 s 的複數只加 '，不規則複數加 's
steps.p: 兩個以上的護理師：the nurses' room（只加一撇）；children、men 這種不規則複數沒有 s，照樣加 's：the children's books。

ex.en: The nurses' room is small.
ex.zh: 護理師們的休息室很小。

ex.en: The children's toys are new.

drills.q: ___ phone is new.
drills.why: 說「Amy 的」要在 Amy 後面加 's。

drills.q: The ___ room is big. (兩位以上護理師的房間)
drills.why: nurses 已經有 s，只加一撇：nurses'。

drills.q: My ___ (brother，所有格) name is Ben.
drills.why: 一個哥哥（單數）的，加 's：brother's。

drills.q: Lisa bag is red.
drills.why: 說「Lisa 的包包」要寫 Lisa's bag。

steps.t: 第一次提到用 a／an，再提到就用 the
steps.p: 第一次講，對方還不知道是哪一個，用 a／an；第二次再講同一個，就變成 the（那個）。

ex.en: I see a dog. The dog is big.
ex.zh: 我看到一隻狗。那隻狗很大。

ex.en: She has a bag. The bag is new.
ex.zh: 她有一個包包。那個包包是新的。

steps.t: 雙方都知道是哪一個，直接用 the
steps.p: 房間裡的那扇門、正在照顧你的那位醫師——不用解釋對方也知道是哪一個，就用 the。

ex.en: Please close the door.
The doctor is here.

steps.t: the 單複數都能配，a／an 只能配單數
steps.p: the bed、the beds 都可以；a beds 不行。世界上只有一個的東西也用 the：the sun、the moon。

ex.en: The masks are on the table.
The sun is hot today.

mistakes.bad: I have a bag. A bag is blue.
mistakes.good: I have a bag. The bag is blue.
mistakes.why: 第二次提到同一個包包，要改用 the。
太陽只有一個，前面要加 the。

drills.q: I have a cat. ___ cat is white.
drills.why: 第二次提到同一隻貓，用 the。

drills.q: Please turn off ___ light.
drills.why: 房間裡的那盞燈，雙方都知道是哪一個，用 the。

drills.q: She has a book. ___ book is about nursing.（填 a、an 或 the）
drills.why: 第二次提到同一本書，用 the。

drills.q: ___ moon is bright tonight.
drills.why: 月亮只有一個，用 the。

drills.q: He is ___ doctor. He works in Taipei.（填 a、an 或 the）
drills.why: 第一次介紹他的職業，用 a。

drills.q: I have a pen. A pen is red.
accept: I have a pen. The pen is red.
drills.why: 第二句講的是同一支筆，用 the。

drills.q: Look at moon.
drills.why: 月亮只有一個，前面要加 the。

steps.t: 講習慣、常做的事，用現在式
steps.p: 用現在簡單式說反覆的習慣。I、you、we、they 的肯定句用動詞原形，下一步看 he、she、it 怎麼變。

ex.en: I drink water every day.
We study at night.

steps.t: 主詞是 he／she／it（一個人、一個東西），動詞加 s
steps.p: 這叫「第三人稱單數」。I、you、we、they 都不用加。否定句用 do not（don't）或 does not（doesn't）：I、you、we、they 配 do not，he、she、it 配 does not，後面的動詞回到原形（she works → she does not work，does 已經表示第三人稱單數，work 不再加 s）。

ex.en: She works in a hospital.
The nurse checks the patient.
She works in the morning. She does not work at night.
ex.zh: 她早上工作。她晚上不工作。

ex.en: They do not visit on Sundays.

steps.t: 加 s 的小規則
steps.p: 大部分加 -s；s、x、ch、sh、o 結尾加 -es；子音 + y 把 y 改成 ies；have 變成 has。

ex.en: He watches TV.
She has a fever.

mistakes.why: she 是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 s。
they 是複數，動詞不加 s。

drills.q: My father ___ coffee every morning.
drills.why: my father 是一個人，動詞加 s。

drills.q: The nurses ___ work at seven.
drills.why: nurses 是複數，動詞用原形。

drills.q: He ___ (go) to school by bus.
drills.why: o 結尾加 -es。（by bus 是「搭公車」，by 後面直接接交通工具。）

drills.q: She ___ a headache.
drills.why: have 配 she 要變成 has。

drills.q: My sister ___ (study) English every day.
drills.why: 子音 + y，把 y 改成 ies。

drills.q: He wash his hands before lunch.
accept: He washes his hands before lunch.
drills.why: he 後面的動詞要加 s；sh 結尾加 -es。

drills.q: I likes this book.
drills.why: I 後面的動詞不加 s。

steps.t: 動詞後面用 me、you、him、her、it、us、them
steps.p: 放在主詞位置用 I、he、she、we、they；放在動詞後面、當「被做的人」，要換成 me、him、her、us、them（you 和 it 不變）。

ex.en: She helps me.
I like them.

steps.t: him、her、them 指前面說過的人
steps.p: 前面已經說過是誰，後面就用 him／her／them 代替，不用再說一次名字。

ex.en: Dr. Lin is kind. The patients love her.
ex.zh: 林醫師很親切，病人都很愛她。

ex.en: My brother calls us.

drills.q: Ann is my friend. I like ___.
drills.why: 動詞 like 後面要用受格：her。

drills.q: Tom and Lily help ___. (我們)
drills.why: 動詞 help 後面用受格：us。

drills.q: My dog loves ___ (我).
drills.why: 動詞 loves 後面用受格：me。

drills.q: He calls I.
drills.why: I 只能當主詞，動詞後面要用 me。

steps.t: 否定：do not／does not + 原形
steps.p: 一般動詞不能直接加 not，要請 do／does 幫忙。he／she／it 用 does not（doesn't），其他用 do not（don't）。

ex.en: I do not eat meat.
He does not smoke.

steps.t: does 出現了，後面動詞打回原形
steps.p: s 已經加在 does 身上了，後面的動詞不用再加 s。

ex.en: She doesn't like milk.
It doesn't hurt.

steps.t: 問句：Do／Does 放最前面
steps.p: Do you…? Does he…? 動詞一樣用原形。回答：Yes, I do.／No, she doesn't.

ex.en: Do you take any medicine?
Does she live here?

mistakes.why: doesn't 後面用原形 eat。
she 要用 Does。

drills.q: ___ you drink coffee?
drills.why: you 配 Do；一般動詞的問句不用 Are。

drills.q: She ___ like fish.
drills.why: she 用 doesn't。

drills.q: Does he ___ (have) a fever?
drills.why: Does 後面的動詞用原形，不是 has。

drills.q: They ___ live in Taichung.
drills.why: they 用 don't。

drills.q: My brother ___ (not，play) basketball.
drills.why: my brother 是單數，用 doesn't + 原形。

drills.q: Does she needs help?
drills.why: Does 後面用原形 need。

drills.q: I not like coffee.
drills.why: 一般動詞的否定要加 do：do not like。

steps.t: 現在正在做：be 動詞 + 動詞 ing
steps.p: am／is／are 照主詞選，後面的動詞加 ing。兩個都要有，少一個就錯。

ex.en: I am eating lunch.
She is sleeping.

steps.t: 加 ing 的小規則
steps.p: 加 -ing 多半直接加。不發音的 e 先去掉（write → writing）。以美式拼法為例，末音節有重音，字尾是一個短母音加一個子音字母時，常把子音寫兩次，例如 run → running、sit → sitting、begin → beginning。字尾的 w、x、y 照原樣寫，例如 fix → fixing。open 和 visit 的重音在前面，寫 opening 和 visiting。

ex.en: He is writing a note.
They are running.

steps.t: 和現在式的差別
steps.p: 現在式講習慣（every day、usually）；現在進行式講此刻（now、right now、Look!）。

ex.en: She works every day.
She is working now.

mistakes.why: 少了 be 動詞。
be 動詞後面的動詞要加 ing。

drills.q: Look! The baby ___.
drills.why: Look! 表示此刻正在發生，用 is crying。

drills.q: They ___ TV now.
drills.why: they 配 are，動詞加 ing。

drills.q: She ___ (take) a shower right now.
drills.why: she 配 is；take 去 e 加 ing。

drills.q: I ___ a letter now.
drills.why: I 配 am，動詞加 ing。

drills.q: The children ___ (run) in the park now.
drills.why: children 是複數，配 are；run 要多寫一個 n。

drills.q: He is sit on the bed.
accept: He is sitting on the bed.
drills.why: is 後面的動詞要加 ing，sit 要多寫一個 t。

drills.q: We watching a movie now.
accept: We are watching a movie now.
drills.why: 少了 be 動詞 are。

steps.t: 過去的狀態：am／is 變 was，are 變 were
steps.p: I、he、she、it 和單數主詞用 was；you、we、they 和複數用 were。

steps.p: 否定加 not（wasn't、weren't）；問句把 was／were 搬到主詞前面。

ex.en: He wasn't in his room.
Were you nervous?

they 配 were。

drills.why: last week 是過去；she 配 was。

drills.why: we 配 were。

drills.why: the test 是單數，過去用 was。

drills.why: you 配 Were；yesterday 是過去。

drills.q: My parents ___ (be，否定) at home last night.
drills.why: parents 是複數，配 were；否定加 not。

drills.q: He were sick last week.
drills.why: he 配 was。

drills.q: I am born in 2004.
drills.why: 出生是過去的事，用 was born。

steps.t: 過去做的事：動詞加 ed
steps.p: 不管主詞是誰都一樣，不用管 he／she 要不要加 s。

ex.en: I walked to school yesterday.
She called the doctor.

steps.t: 加 ed 的小規則
steps.p: 規則動詞以 e 結尾只加 -d，子音字母加 y 結尾把 y 改成 -ied。以美式拼法為例，末音節重讀且以短母音加一個子音字母結尾時，常雙寫子音再加 -ed，例如 stop → stopped、admit → admitted。fix → fixed 的 x 不雙寫，visit → visited 的重音不在末音節。

ex.en: He lived in Tainan.
She stopped the bleeding.

steps.t: ed 有三種唸法
steps.p: t、d 結尾唸「id」（wanted、needed）；p、k、s、sh、ch、f 的音後面唸「t」（walked、washed）；其他唸「d」（called、cleaned）。

ex.en: I needed help.
We washed our hands.

mistakes.why: 子音 + y，把 y 改成 ied。
yesterday 是過去，動詞要加 ed。

drills.q: I ___ my room yesterday.
drills.why: yesterday 是過去，用 cleaned。

drills.q: She ___ English last night.
drills.why: study 的過去式是 studied。

drills.q: He ___ (stop) the car a minute ago.
drills.why: 短母音 + 一個子音，p 多寫一次再加 ed。

drills.q: They ___ in Japan in 2020.
drills.why: in 2020 是過去，用 lived。

drills.q: The nurse ___ (wash) her hands a minute ago.
drills.why: 過去的事，加 ed。

drills.q: We watch a movie last night.
accept: We watched a movie last night.
drills.why: last night 是過去，動詞要加 ed。

drills.q: He planed a trip last month.
accept: He planned a trip last month.
drills.why: plan 要多寫一個 n 再加 ed。

steps.p: I went、she went、they went，都不用加 s。

ex.en: They had lunch at noon.

eat 的過去式是 ate。

drills.why: drink 的過去式是 drank。

drills.q: The patient ___ dizzy this morning.
drills.why: feel 的過去式是 felt。

drills.q: They ___ (come) to the hospital yesterday.
drills.why: come 的過去式是 came。

drills.q: I sleeped for eight hours last night.
accept: I slept for eight hours last night.
drills.why: sleep 的過去式是 slept。

drills.q: She gived me a pen yesterday.
accept: She gave me a pen yesterday.
drills.why: give 的過去式是 gave。

steps.t: 否定：did not + 原形
steps.p: 過去式的否定，不管主詞是誰都用 did not（didn't），後面的動詞打回原形。

ex.en: I didn't sleep well.
She did not take the medicine.

steps.t: 問句：Did 放最前面 + 原形
steps.p: 回答：Yes, I did.／No, I didn't.

ex.en: Did you eat breakfast?
Did he call you?

steps.t: 「過去」的記號只出現一次
steps.p: did 已經是過去式了，後面的動詞不能再用過去式：didn't went ✗，didn't go ✓。

ex.en: He didn't go to work.
Did she see the doctor?

mistakes.why: didn't 後面用原形 go。

drills.q: She ___ come to class yesterday.
drills.why: yesterday 是過去，一般動詞的否定用 didn't。

drills.q: Did you ___ the medicine?
drills.why: Did 後面用原形。

drills.q: He didn't ___ (eat) dinner last night.
drills.why: didn't 後面用原形。

drills.q: ___ they call the doctor last night?
drills.why: last night 是過去，一般動詞的問句用 Did。

drills.q: I ___ (not，see) him yesterday.
drills.why: 過去式的否定：did not + 原形。

drills.q: Did she went home?
drills.why: Did 後面用原形 go。

drills.q: We didn't had time.
drills.why: didn't 後面用原形 have。

steps.t: will + 原形：之後會做的事
steps.p: 不管主詞是誰，will 都不變，後面接原形。縮寫 I'll、she'll；否定 will not = won't。

ex.en: The doctor will see you soon.
I won't be late.

steps.t: be going to + 原形：已經打算好的事
steps.p: be 動詞照主詞變（am／is／are）。

ex.en: I am going to study tonight.
She is going to have surgery tomorrow.

steps.t: 問句
steps.p: will 的問句把 Will 放最前面；be going to 的問句把 be 動詞放最前面。

ex.en: Will it hurt?
Are you going to stay here?

mistakes.why: will 後面用原形。

mistakes.good: I am going to call him.
mistakes.why: be going to 少了 be 動詞。

drills.q: I ___ call you tomorrow.
drills.why: will + 原形。

drills.q: She is going to ___ a nurse.
drills.why: going to 後面接原形 be。

drills.q: They will ___ (arrive) at nine.
drills.why: will 後面用原形。

drills.q: We ___ going to visit Grandma this weekend.
drills.why: we 配 are going to。

drills.q: He ___ come today.（will 的否定）
drills.why: will 的否定是 will not（won't）。

drills.q: He will comes back soon.
drills.why: will 後面用原形 come。

drills.q: They is going to move next month.
accept: They are going to move next month.
drills.why: they 配 are。

steps.t: 已經約好、排進行程的事，用 am／is／are＋V-ing
steps.p: 跟人約好、已經排好的事，可以用現在進行式。未來的時間要讓對方聽得出來。可以說出 tomorrow、next week，也可以由前面的對話交代。

ex.en: I am meeting Dr. Lin tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要跟林醫師見面。

ex.en: We are flying to Tokyo next week.
A: What are your plans for tomorrow? B: I'm meeting Amy.
ex.zh: A：你明天有什麼安排？B：我要和 Amy 見面。問句已經說了「明天」，回答不用再說一次。

steps.t: 沒有約好、只是打算或猜，用 be going to 或 will
steps.p: 說自己的打算時，可以用 be going to。說預測時，可以用 will。想突出事情已經約好或排進行程時，用 be＋V-ing。

ex.en: I am going to study tonight.
I think it will rain.

drills.q: I ___ my teacher at 3 p.m. tomorrow. (已經約好)
drills.why: am meeting 表示這次見面已經約好。句中的 tomorrow 交代了時間。

drills.q: She ___ to Kaohsiung next Monday. (票已經買好)
drills.why: 已經排好的行程用 is going；went 是過去，go 不配 she。

drills.q: We ___ (have) dinner with Amy tonight. (已經約好)
drills.why: 已經約好的事，用 are＋having。

drills.q: I meeting my friend tomorrow.
accept: I am meeting my friend tomorrow.
drills.why: 進行式一定要有 be 動詞：I am meeting。

steps.t: 助動詞 + 原形
steps.p: can（能、可以）、should（應該）、must（必須）、may（可以、可能）後面一律接原形；主詞是 he／she 也不加 s。

ex.en: She can swim.
You should rest.

steps.t: 否定直接加 not，問句搬到最前面
steps.p: cannot（can't）、should not（shouldn't）、must not（mustn't）。問句：Can you…? Should I…?

ex.en: You must not smoke here.
Can you stand up?

steps.t: have to 像一般動詞
steps.p: 否定用 don't／doesn't have to，問句用 Do／Does … have to…? 注意：must not 是「不准」，don't have to 是「不必」，意思差很多。

ex.en: You don't have to wait.
Does she have to work today?

mistakes.why: 助動詞後面用原形。
she 要用 doesn't。

drills.q: You ___ wash your hands before eating.
drills.why: should 後面直接接原形，不加 to，也不加 s。

drills.q: He can ___ English.
drills.why: can 後面用原形。

drills.q: She must ___ (take) this medicine after meals.
drills.why: must 後面用原形。

drills.q: It is Sunday. You ___ go to school today.
drills.why: 週日「不必」上學，用 don't have to；must not 是「不准」。

drills.q: She ___ (can，否定) walk without help.
drills.why: can 的否定是 cannot（can't）。

drills.q: You should to drink more water.
drills.why: should 後面不加 to。

drills.q: He musts go now.
drills.why: 助動詞不加 s。

steps.t: 時間：at 幾點、on 哪一天、in 月份年份
steps.p: at 配一個時間點（at nine、at noon、at night）；on 配日子（on Monday、on May 5）；in 配比較長的一段（in June、in 2026、in the morning）。

ex.en: The class starts at nine.
My birthday is in November.

steps.t: 地點：at 一個點、in 裡面、on 表面
steps.p: at the door 在門口、in the room 在房間裡、on the table 在桌上。

ex.en: She is at the bus stop.
The keys are on the table.

steps.t: 去哪裡用 to；有些說法要整組記
steps.p: go to school、go to the hospital；但 go home 不加 to。at home、at work、in bed、on the second floor 整組背。

ex.en: He goes to work by bus.
She is in bed.

mistakes.why: 幾點用 at。
go home 不加 to。

drills.q: Your appointment is ___ Friday.
drills.why: 星期幾用 on。

drills.q: The surgery starts ___ 8:30.
drills.why: 幾點用 at。

drills.q: The medicine is ___ the bag.（在裡面，一個字）
drills.why: 在裡面用 in。

drills.q: She was born ___ 2005.
drills.why: 年份用 in。

drills.q: The phone is ___ the table.（在上面，一個字）
drills.why: 在表面上用 on。

drills.q: I take a walk on the morning.
accept: I take a walk in the morning.
drills.why: 早上是 in the morning。

drills.q: We have a test in Monday.
accept: We have a test on Monday.
drills.why: 星期幾用 on。

table.title: at、on、in
head: 介系詞
時間
地點
rows: on the table、on the wall、on the second floor

steps.t: 數得出來和數不出來
steps.p: apple、pill、nurse 可以一個一個數。water、blood、rice 和 money 在這裡表示總量，當不可數名詞。依意思選用法。medicine 泛指藥物時可以說 some medicine，指不同藥物可以說 two different medicines。pain 泛指疼痛時可以說 in pain，描述一陣刺痛可以說 a sharp pain。

ex.en: I ate two apples.
Drink some water.

steps.t: many／a few 配可數，much／a little 配不可數
steps.p: a lot of 兩種都能配，不確定的時候用它最安全。

ex.en: How many pills do you take?
How much water did you drink?

steps.t: some 用在肯定句，any 用在否定句和問句
steps.p: 但是請人吃喝、提出邀請時，問句也用 some。

ex.en: I don't have any questions.
Would you like some tea?

mistakes.bad: How many water do you drink?
mistakes.good: How much water do you drink?
mistakes.why: water 不可數，用 much。
information 不可數，不加 s。

drills.q: How ___ pills did you take?
drills.why: pills 可數，用 many。

drills.q: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
drills.why: 否定句用 any。（There isn't 是「沒有」：there is／there are 的用法，單元 17 會細講。）

drills.q: How ___ time do we have?（much 或 many）
drills.why: time 不可數，用 much。

drills.q: I have ___ questions.
drills.why: questions 可數，用 a few。

drills.q: She drank ___ little water.
drills.instruction: 她喝了一點水。填一個字。
drills.why: a little water 是「一點水」。too little water 是「水量太少」，意思不同。

drills.q: He doesn't have some money.
drills.why: 否定句用 any。

drills.q: How much brothers do you have?
accept: How many brothers do you have?
drills.why: brothers 可數，用 many。

table.title: 可數和不可數配什麼字
head: 意思
可數（複數）
不可數

steps.t: 兩個比：形容詞 + er + than
steps.p: 短形容詞通常加 -er。以 e 結尾只加 -r，子音字母加 y 結尾把 y 改成 -ier。像 big、hot 這類單音節、以短母音加一個子音字母結尾的字，先雙寫再加 -er。字尾 w、x 照原樣，例如 low → lower、lax → laxer。

ex.en: He is taller than me.
Today is hotter than yesterday.

steps.t: 長的字用 more
steps.p: 三個音節以上（和多數兩個音節）的形容詞：more + 形容詞 + than，不加 er。

ex.en: This bed is more comfortable.
English is more difficult than Chinese.

steps.t: 三個以上比出「最」：the + est 或 the most
steps.p: 不規則的要背：good → better → best、bad → worse → worst、many／much → more → most。

ex.en: This is the biggest room.
The pain is worse than yesterday.

mistakes.bad: She is more tall than me.
mistakes.why: tall 是短的字，加 er，不用 more。

mistakes.bad: This is the most big room.
mistakes.why: big 的最高級是 biggest。

drills.q: This box is ___ than that one.
drills.why: 兩個比，用比較級 heavier。

drills.q: She is the ___ student in the class.
drills.why: the 後面、全班裡最…，用最高級。

drills.q: My headache is ___ (bad) than yesterday.
drills.why: bad 的比較級是 worse。

drills.q: This book is ___ than that one.
drills.why: interesting 是長的字，用 more。

drills.q: He is the ___ (good) doctor in the hospital.
drills.why: good 的最高級是 best。

drills.q: Today is more cold than yesterday.
drills.why: cold 是短的字，加 er。

drills.q: She is beautifuler than her sister.
accept: She is more beautiful than her sister.
drills.why: beautiful 是長的字，用 more。

steps.t: 疑問詞放最前面
steps.p: What 什麼、Where 哪裡、When 什麼時候、Who 誰、Why 為什麼、How 怎麼樣。

ex.en: Where is the pain?
When is your birthday?

steps.t: 疑問詞後面照一般問句的順序
steps.p: be 動詞的句子：疑問詞 + be + 主詞；一般動詞的句子：疑問詞 + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形。

ex.en: What do you eat for breakfast?
Why did he leave?

steps.t: How 的家族；Who 當主詞時不加 did
steps.p: How long 多久、How often 多常、How many／much 多少。問「誰做的」：Who called you?（who 就是主詞，直接接動詞）；問「對象」才加 did：Who did you call?

ex.en: How often do you take this medicine?
Who called you?

mistakes.why: 一般動詞的問句要加 do。
does 後面用原形。

drills.q: ___ do you live?
drills.why: 問地點用 Where。

drills.q: ___ did the pain start? — Last night.
drills.why: 回答是時間，用 When。

drills.q: How ___ do you exercise? — Twice a week.（填一個字）
drills.why: 問「多常」用 How often。

drills.q: What ___ she do?
drills.why: she 配 does。

drills.q: ___ is your doctor? — Dr. Lin.（疑問詞）
drills.why: 問「誰」用 Who。

drills.q: Why you are late?
drills.why: 問句要把 be 動詞放到主詞前面。

drills.q: Where does he lives?
drills.why: does 後面用原形 live。

steps.t: 「有」：There is + 單數或不可數，There are + 複數
steps.p: 看後面的名詞決定用 is 還是 are。

ex.en: There is a chair in the room.
There are two nurses on duty.

steps.t: 過去用 There was／There were；問句把 be 動詞搬到前面
steps.p: 問句：Is there…? Are there…? 回答用 Yes, there is.／No, there aren't.

ex.en: There was a car accident yesterday.
Is there any water?

steps.t: 天氣、時間、距離用 It 當主詞
steps.p: 這個 it 沒有意思，只是佔位子。後面才講真正的事：It is important to…

ex.en: It is raining.
It is important to rest.

mistakes.bad: There have a book on the desk.
mistakes.good: There is a book on the desk.
mistakes.why: 「某個地方有…」用 There is，不用 have。
people 是複數，用 are。

drills.q: ___ a pharmacy near here.
drills.why: 「有一間藥局」用 There is。

drills.q: ___ five people in my family.
drills.why: five people 是複數，用 There are。

drills.q: ___ is cold today.（填一個字）
drills.why: 講天氣用 It 當主詞。

drills.q: ___ any milk in the fridge?
drills.why: milk 不可數，問句用 Is there。

drills.q: There ___ (be) two doctors here yesterday.
drills.why: two doctors 是複數；yesterday 是過去，用 were。

drills.q: There are a pen on the table.
accept: There is a pen on the table.
drills.why: a pen 是單數，用 is。

drills.q: There is important to drink water.
accept: It is important to drink water.
drills.why: 「做某件事很重要」用 It is important to…。

table.title: There 和 It
head: 句型
什麼時候用
例子
rows: There is some blood on the dressing.

steps.t: 頻率副詞：從「總是」到「從不」
steps.p: always（總是）＞ usually（通常）＞ often（常常）＞ sometimes（有時）＞ never（從不）。

ex.en: I always wash my hands.
He never eats breakfast.

steps.t: 位置：一般動詞前面、be 動詞後面
steps.p: sometimes、usually、often 也可以放句首或句尾。

ex.en: She usually gets up at six.
He is often late.

steps.t: 次數：once、twice、three times + a day／a week，放句尾
steps.p: every four hours 是「每四小時」。問「多常」用 How often。

ex.en: Take this pill twice a day.
I exercise three times a week.

mistakes.why: never 放在一般動詞前面。
頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面。

drills.q: I ___ late for class.
drills.why: 頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面。

drills.q: Take this medicine ___.
drills.why: 次數 + a day，times 要加 s。

drills.q: She ___ (usually，get) up at six.
drills.why: usually 放在一般動詞前面；she 的動詞加 s。

drills.q: ___ do you exercise? — Twice a week.
drills.why: 問「多常」用 How often。

drills.q: Brush your teeth ___ a day.（兩次，一個字）
drills.why: 兩次是 twice。

drills.q: He goes often to the gym.
accept: He often goes to the gym.
drills.why: often 放在一般動詞前面。

drills.q: I take this pill two time a day.
accept: I take this pill two times a day.
I take this pill twice a day.
drills.why: 兩次是 twice 或 two times，time 要加 s。

steps.t: 叫對方做事：原形動詞開頭，沒有主詞
steps.p: 句子直接從動詞開始。加 please 比較有禮貌。

ex.en: Sit down, please.
Take a deep breath.

steps.t: 叫對方不要做：Do not（Don't）+ 原形
steps.p: 不管對方是誰都用 Don't。

ex.en: Don't move.
Please do not eat after midnight.

steps.t: 更客氣的請求和清楚的指示
steps.p: 客氣：Could you／Can you + 原形…? 清楚直接：I need you to + 原形（護理師請病人配合時很常用）。

ex.en: Could you lie down, please?
I need you to stay in bed.

mistakes.why: Don't 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
Could you 後面接原形。

drills.q: ___ your hand, please.
drills.why: 祈使句用原形動詞開頭。

drills.q: ___ touch the wound.
drills.why: 叫對方不要做，用 Don't + 原形。

drills.q: Could you ___ (sit) here, please?
drills.why: Could you 後面用原形。

drills.q: I need you ___ still.
drills.why: I need you to + 原形。

drills.q: Please ___ (not，worry).
drills.why: 否定的祈使句：do not + 原形。

drills.q: Please to sit down.
drills.why: Please 後面直接接原形。

drills.q: Doesn't eat before the test.
accept: Do not eat before the test.
drills.why: 祈使句的否定一律用 Don't。

I need you to open your mouth.

steps.t: every／each 接單數名詞
steps.p: every 和 each 都是「每一個」，後面接單數名詞，動詞也用單數；everyone、everything 也是單數。

ex.en: Every room has a window.
Everyone is here.

steps.t: all／most／none 和 both／either／neither
steps.p: all 全部、most 大部分、none 一個都沒有；兩個東西用 both（兩個都）、either（任一個）、neither（兩個都不）。most、none、either、neither 接 the、my 或代名詞要加 of；all、both 的 of 可加可不加（both my sisters＝both of my sisters），接代名詞（them、us）一定要 of。

ex.en: All of my friends are nurses.
ex.zh: 我的朋友全都是護理師。

ex.en: Neither of them was late.

steps.t: one／ones 和 something／anything／nothing
steps.p: 前面說過的可數名詞用 one／ones 代替；不知道是誰、什麼，用 somebody、something；問句和否定句多用 anybody、anything；nothing 本身就是否定。

ex.en: I need a new one.
I didn't see anything.

mistakes.why: every 後面接單數名詞，動詞也用單數。
not 已經是否定，後面用 anything，不能再用 nothing。

drills.q: ___ patient has a call button.
drills.why: 後面是單數 patient、動詞 has，用 Every。

drills.q: ___ my parents are teachers.
drills.why: 兩個人都是，動詞用 are，用 Both。

drills.q: This cup is dirty. Can I have a clean ___?（填一個字）
drills.why: 代替前面的單數可數名詞 cup，用 one。

drills.q: I didn't see ___ in the room.
drills.why: 否定句用 anything；用 nothing 會變成雙重否定。

drills.q: ___ of my roommates smokes. They both hate it.（填一個字）
drills.why: 兩個都不，用 Neither。

drills.q: All of the bed are full.
accept: All of the beds are full.
drills.why: all of the 後面接複數名詞 beds。

drills.q: Somebody are at the door.
drills.why: somebody 當主詞是單數，動詞用 is。

table.title: 說範圍的字
head: 字
意思
後面接
例子
rows: 全部／大部分／一個都沒有
複數名詞（most、none 接 the、my 要加 of；all 可省）
All of the beds are full.
兩個都／任一個／兩個都不

steps.t: and 把東西加起來，but 表示轉折
steps.p: and 接同方向的事；but 接相反或意外的事。

ex.en: I have a cough and a fever.
He is tired, but he can't sleep.

steps.t: so 後面是結果，because 後面是原因
steps.p: 同一件事可以用兩種方式說，順序相反。

ex.en: I was sick, so I stayed home.
I stayed home because I was sick.
ex.zh: 我待在家，因為我生病了。

steps.t: 「因為…所以…」英文只能選一個
steps.p: 中文習慣兩個一起說，英文 because 和 so 只能用其中一個。

ex.en: Because it rained, we stayed home.
It rained, so we stayed home.
ex.zh: 下雨了，所以我們待在家。

mistakes.bad: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
mistakes.good: Because I was tired, I went to bed.
mistakes.why: because 和 so 只能用一個。

mistakes.bad: He didn't eat so he was full.
mistakes.good: He didn't eat because he was full.
mistakes.why: 「吃飽了」是原因，要用 because。

drills.q: I was hungry, ___ I ate a sandwich.
drills.why: 「吃三明治」是結果，用 so。

drills.q: She wants to go, ___ she is too busy.
drills.why: 想去卻太忙，是轉折，用 but。

drills.q: He is weak ___ he did not eat.（因為，一個字）
drills.why: 後面是原因，用 because。

drills.q: He took the medicine ___ went to bed.
drills.why: 兩個接著做的動作，用 and。

drills.q: It was late, ___ we went home.（所以，一個字）
drills.why: 後面是結果，用 so。

drills.q: Because it was late, so I took a taxi.
accept: Because it was late, I took a taxi.
It was late, so I took a taxi.
drills.why: because 和 so 只能留一個。

drills.q: I like tea, so I don't like coffee.
accept: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
drills.why: 喜歡茶、不喜歡咖啡是對比，用 but。

steps.t: 這四個字後面接一個完整的句子
steps.p: when（當…的時候）、before（在…之前）、after（在…之後）、if（如果）後面接「主詞 + 動詞」。

ex.en: Call me when you get home.
Wash your hands before you eat.

steps.t: before／after 後面也可以接名詞或 V-ing
steps.p: 例如 after meals（飯後）、before surgery（手術前）、before going to bed（睡前）。

ex.en: Take this pill after meals.
Brush your teeth before going to bed.

steps.t: 講未來：這幾個字後面用現在式，主要句才用 will
steps.p: 說「……的時候」「如果……」的未來：when、if 後面用現在式（不說 I'll call you when you will come）。但 when 當「什麼時候」、if 當「是不是」時，後面可以用 will：Tell me when you will arrive.（告訴我你什麼時候會到）

ex.en: I will call you when I arrive.
If it rains, we will stay home.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我們就待在家。

ex.en: Tell me when you will arrive.
ex.zh: 告訴我你什麼時候會到。（when＝什麼時候，可以用 will）

mistakes.bad: I will call you when I will arrive.
mistakes.good: I will call you when I arrive.
mistakes.why: when 後面講未來的事用現在式。
before 後面的動詞用 ing（或接完整句子 before you eat）。

drills.q: Press the button ___ you need help.
drills.why: 「如果需要幫忙」用 if。

drills.q: Brush your teeth ___ you go to bed.
drills.why: 睡覺「之前」刷牙，用 before。

drills.q: I will tell him when he ___ (come) back.
drills.why: when 後面講未來用現在式；he 的動詞加 s。

drills.q: Take this medicine ___ meals.
drills.why: after 後面可以直接接名詞 meals。

drills.q: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will stay home.
drills.why: if 後面講未來用現在式。

drills.q: Call me if you will need help.
accept: Call me if you need help.
drills.why: 這裡的 if 是「如果」，後面用現在式，不用 will。（if 當「是不是」時才可能接 will：I don't know if he will come.）

drills.q: After she will finish work, she will go home.
accept: After she finishes work, she will go home.
drills.why: after 後面用現在式 finishes。

extra.title: 一定會發生的事實：If＋現在式，現在式

steps.t: 說「只要……就一定……」的事實，兩邊都用現在式
steps.p: 自然現象、身體反應、每次都一樣的結果，if 後面和結果都用現在式。if 那半句放前面時，後面加逗號。

ex.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
If I don't sleep, I feel tired.
ex.zh: 我只要沒睡，就會覺得累。

steps.t: 這種 if 可以換成 when
steps.p: 每次都會發生，所以 if 換成 when 意思差不多：When you heat ice, it melts.。只是「可能發生一次、看情況」的事，結果用 will，第 26 單元會教。

ex.en: When water boils, it makes bubbles.
If you press this button, the light goes on.
ex.zh: 只要按這個按鈕，燈就會亮。

drills.q: If you mix red and white, you ___ pink.
drills.why: 每次都一樣的結果，用現在式 get。

drills.q: If water ___ 100°C, it boils.
drills.why: water 是單數，現在式加 s：reaches。

drills.q: If you press this button, the light ___ (go) on.
drills.why: 事實用現在式；the light 是單數，go 加 es：goes。

drills.q: If you heat ice, it melted.
accept: If you heat ice, it melts.
drills.why: 一定會發生的事實，結果也用現在式：it melts。

steps.t: 這些動詞後面接 to + 原形
steps.p: 常見的有 want、need、decide、hope、plan、would like。

ex.en: He wants to go home.
I need to rest.

steps.t: 這些動詞後面接動詞 ing
steps.p: enjoy、finish、avoid、keep、mind。介系詞後面的動詞也用 ing。

ex.en: She finished eating.
Thank you for helping me.

steps.t: 有些兩種都能接，但意思不同
steps.p: stop smoking 是「戒菸」；stop to smoke 是「停下來去抽菸」。

ex.en: He stopped smoking last year.
He stopped to buy some water.

mistakes.why: want 後面要 to + 原形。
enjoy 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: I need ___ a doctor.
drills.why: need 後面接 to + 原形。

drills.q: He enjoys ___ basketball.
drills.why: enjoy 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: She decided ___ (study) nursing.
drills.why: decide 後面接 to + 原形。

drills.q: Please keep ___.
drills.why: keep 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: Wash your hands before ___ (eat).
drills.why: 介系詞 before 後面的動詞用 ing。

drills.q: I finished to write the report.
drills.why: finish 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: They hope visiting Japan next year.
accept: They hope to visit Japan next year.
drills.why: hope 後面接 to + 原形。

steps.t: 過去某個時間點正在做：was／were + 動詞 ing
steps.p: I、he、she、it 用 was；you、we、they 用 were。

ex.en: I was sleeping at ten last night.
They were eating dinner.

steps.t: 一件事正在進行，另一件事突然發生
steps.p: 長的、進行中的用過去進行式；短的、突然發生的用過去式，常用 when 連接。

ex.en: He was sleeping when I came in.
ex.zh: 我進來的時候他在睡覺。

ex.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
ex.zh: 電話響的時候我在煮飯。

steps.t: while + 過去進行式
steps.p: while（在…的期間）後面常接正在進行的那件事。

ex.en: She fell while she was walking to the bathroom.
ex.zh: 她走去浴室的時候跌倒了。

ex.en: What were you doing at that time?

mistakes.bad: I was sleep when you called.
mistakes.good: I was sleeping when you called.
mistakes.why: was 後面的動詞要加 ing。
they 配 were。

drills.q: I ___ a shower when the phone rang.
drills.why: 電話響的時候「正在」洗澡，用過去進行式。

drills.q: What ___ you doing at nine last night?
drills.why: you 配 were。

drills.q: He ___ (sleep) when the nurse came in.
drills.why: 護理師進來時他「正在」睡，用 was sleeping。

drills.q: She was walking to the toilet when she ___.
drills.why: 突然發生的短動作用過去式 fell。

drills.q: They ___ (watch) TV at eight last night.
drills.instruction: 請用過去進行式，描述八點當下正在做的事。
drills.why: 昨晚八點正在看，用 were watching。

drills.q: I was cook dinner when he arrived.
accept: I was cooking dinner when he arrived.
drills.why: was 後面的動詞要加 ing。

drills.q: We was studying at that time.
accept: We were studying at that time.
drills.why: we 配 were。

公式

steps.t: have／has + 過去分詞
steps.p: he／she／it 用 has，其他用 have。過去分詞：規則動詞跟過去式一樣（加 ed），不規則的要背。

ex.en: I have finished my homework.
She has lived here for three years.

steps.t: 三種用法：經驗、持續到現在、剛完成
steps.p: 經驗常配 ever、never、before；持續配 for、since；剛完成配 just、already、yet。

ex.en: Have you ever been to Japan?
I have already eaten.

steps.t: for + 一段時間，since + 起點
steps.p: for two days（兩天）、since Monday（從週一）。

ex.en: She has had a fever for two days.
He has been here since Monday.

mistakes.why: she 用 has。

mistakes.bad: I have lived here since three years.
mistakes.good: I have lived here for three years.
mistakes.why: three years 是一段時間，用 for；since 後面接起點。

drills.q: She ___ already taken the medicine.
drills.why: she 用 has。

drills.q: I have lived here ___ 2020.
drills.why: 2020 是起點，用 since。

drills.q: Have you ___ (eat) breakfast yet?
drills.why: have 後面用過去分詞 eaten。

drills.q: We have known each other ___ ten years.
drills.why: ten years 是一段時間，用 for。

drills.q: He ___ (not，see) the doctor yet.
drills.why: he 用 has；否定加 not，後面用過去分詞 seen。

drills.q: I have saw that movie.
drills.why: have 後面用過去分詞 seen，不是過去式 saw。

drills.q: He have been sick for a week.
accept: He has been sick for a week.
drills.why: he 用 has。

steps.t: 有可能發生的條件：If + 現在式，主要句 will + 原形
steps.p: if 那一句講條件，主要句講結果。

ex.en: If you rest, you will feel better.
ex.zh: 如果你休息，就會好一點。

ex.en: If it rains, I will stay home.

steps.t: if 那一句不用 will
steps.p: if 可以放前面（後面要加逗號）或放後面（不加逗號）。

ex.en: I will call you if I need help.
If she comes, I will tell her.

steps.t: 主要句也可以是祈使句、can、should；unless 是「除非」
steps.p: 衛教最常用：If…，就做某件事。

ex.en: If the pain gets worse, press the call button.
ex.zh: 如果更痛了，就按呼叫鈴。

ex.en: You will not get better unless you rest.
ex.zh: 除非你休息，不然不會好。

mistakes.bad: If it will rain, I will stay home.
mistakes.good: If it rains, I will stay home.
mistakes.why: if 那一句用現在式，不用 will。

mistakes.bad: If he come, I will tell him.
mistakes.good: If he comes, I will tell him.
mistakes.why: he 的現在式動詞要加 s。

drills.q: If you ___ this medicine, you will feel better.
drills.why: if 那一句用現在式。

drills.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
drills.why: 主要句用 will + 原形。

drills.q: If she ___ (call), I will tell you.
drills.why: if 那一句用現在式；she 的動詞加 s。

drills.q: ___ you hurry, you will miss the bus.
drills.why: 「除非你快一點，不然會錯過」用 Unless。

drills.q: If you feel dizzy, ___ (sit) down.
drills.why: 主要句是祈使句，用原形。

drills.q: If I will see him, I will give him the book.
accept: If I see him, I will give him the book.
drills.why: if 那一句用現在式，不用 will。

drills.q: If you don't eat, you are hungry later.
accept: If you don't eat, you will be hungry later.
drills.why: 主要句講之後的結果，用 will be。

steps.t: So am I／Neither do I：附和別人
steps.p: 肯定句用 So＋助動詞＋主詞，否定句用 Neither＋助動詞＋主詞（或 I don't either）。助動詞看前一句：be 動詞用 am／is／are，一般動詞用 do／does／did，can 就用 can。

ex.en: I'm cold. — So am I.
I didn't call her. — Neither did I.

steps.t: Who 當主詞不加 did
steps.p: Who、What 是「做事的人或東西」時，直接接動詞：Who called you? What happened?；問「做了誰、什麼」才用 did：Who did you call?

ex.en: Who opened the window?
Who did you meet?

steps.t: 介系詞放最後、What…like、How long does it take
steps.p: Who are you talking to? 介系詞放句尾；What is it like? 問怎麼樣；How long does it take (you) to＋原形？問花多久，回答 It takes＋時間。

ex.en: What are you looking for?
It takes an hour to get there.

mistakes.bad: I don't like it. — So do I.
mistakes.good: I don't like it. — Neither do I.
mistakes.why: 附和否定句要用 Neither。
Who 當主詞時直接接動詞，不加 did。（要強調「到底是誰真的打來」時才會說 Who did call you?，這一課練一般的問法。）

drills.q: I'm hungry. — So ___ I.
drills.why: 前一句是 be 動詞 am，附和用 So am I。

drills.q: I don't eat meat. — ___ do I.
drills.why: 附和否定句用 Neither。

drills.q: Who ___ the door?（open 的過去式）
drills.why: Who 當主詞，直接接過去式 opened。

drills.q: What is your new teacher ___?
drills.why: What is…like? 問怎麼樣，like 是介系詞。

drills.q: How long does it ___ you to get to school?（填一個字）
drills.why: How long does it take…? 問花多久。

drills.q: Who did help you?
drills.why: Who 當主詞，不加 did，直接用過去式 helped。（強調時才說 Who did help you?，這裡練一般的問法。）

drills.q: I can't drive. — I can't too.
accept: I can't drive. — I can't either.
I can't drive. — Neither can I.
drills.why: 否定句的「也」用 either，不用 too。

head: 要說的
說法
例子
rows: I can't swim. — Neither can I.
What is…like?／How long does it take…?

steps.t: 方向：into、out of、through、across、along
steps.p: into 進去、out of 出來、through 穿過、across 橫越、along 沿著、up／down 往上／往下，接在移動的動詞後面：walk into、run across。

ex.en: She ran out of the room.
We walked through the park.

steps.t: 方法和時間範圍：by、with、from…to、until、during
steps.p: by＋交通或方式（by bus，不加 the），with＋工具；from…to 從…到…，until 直到，during＋名詞（during class），for＋一段時間（for two hours）。

ex.en: I paid by card.
She slept during the movie.
ex.zh: 她看電影的時候睡著了。

steps.t: 固定搭配：afraid of、wait for
steps.p: 有些形容詞和動詞一定配某個介系詞：afraid of、good at、worried about、allergic to、wait for、listen to、look for、look at、take care of。介系詞後面接名詞或動詞 -ing。

ex.en: He is good at cooking.
Please listen to the nurse.

mistakes.why: wait 後面接人或東西要加 for。

mistakes.bad: I go to school by the bus.
mistakes.good: I go to school by bus.
mistakes.why: by＋交通工具，中間不加 the。

drills.q: He walked ___ the room and sat down.
drills.why: 走進房間，方向用 into。

drills.q: I'm afraid ___ dogs.
drills.why: afraid 固定配 of。

drills.q: We go to work ___ train.（填一個字）
drills.why: by＋交通工具。

drills.q: Don't talk ___ the test.
drills.why: during＋名詞：在考試期間。

drills.q: Please wait ___ me here.（填一個字）
drills.why: wait for＋人。

drills.q: She is good in English.
drills.why: 擅長是 good at。

drills.q: Please listen me.
drills.why: listen 後面接人要加 to。

head: 用途
介系詞
例子
rows: wait for／listen to／look for／take care of

extra.title: 常用片語動詞：get up、look for、turn on……

steps.t: 動詞＋小字（up、on、off、for），變成新的意思
steps.p: get up（起床）、wake up（醒來）、look for（找）、turn on／turn off（打開／關掉電器）、put on（穿上）、take off（脫下）。要整組一起記。

ex.en: I get up at seven.
She is looking for her keys.

steps.t: turn on、put on 這種，東西可以放中間；it 和 them 一定放中間
steps.p: turn on the light = turn the light on；換成 it、them 時一定要放中間：turn it on（不能說 turn on it）。look for 不能拆開：look for it。

ex.en: Please turn it off.
Put your jacket on.

drills.q: It's cold. Please ___ your coat.
drills.why: 天氣冷要「穿上」外套：put on。

drills.q: I can't find my phone. I'm ___ it.
drills.why: 找不到東西，正在「找」：looking for。

drills.q: The room is dark. Can you turn ___ the light?
drills.why: 把燈「打開」是 turn on。

drills.q: Please turn on it.
drills.why: turn on 遇到 it，it 一定放中間：turn it on。

steps.t: 有明確的過去時間：用過去式
steps.p: 常見的字：yesterday、last week、two days ago、in 2020、when I was a child。

ex.en: He fell yesterday.
I visited Japan in 2020.

steps.t: 沒講時間、重點是到現在的結果或經驗：用現在完成式
steps.p: 事情發生在以前，但跟現在有關。

ex.en: He has fallen twice this week.
I have lost my key.
ex.zh: 我的鑰匙不見了。（現在還找不到）

steps.t: for／since 從過去到現在：用現在完成式
steps.p: since yesterday 是「從昨天到現在」，不是已經結束的時間。

ex.en: I have been sick since yesterday.
She has worked here for five years.

mistakes.why: yesterday 是明確的過去時間，用過去式。

mistakes.good: She has been sick since Monday.
mistakes.why: 從週一到現在，用現在完成式。

drills.q: I ___ my homework an hour ago.
drills.why: an hour ago 是明確的過去時間，用過去式。

drills.q: She ___ in Taipei since 2020.
drills.why: since 2020 到現在，用現在完成式。

drills.q: We ___ (go) to the beach last Sunday.
drills.why: last Sunday 是明確的過去時間，用過去式。

drills.q: She ___ her leg. She can't walk now.
drills.why: 重點是現在的結果（不能走），用現在完成式。

drills.q: He ___ (be) in the hospital for three days. He is still there.
drills.why: 三天前到現在還在，用現在完成式。

drills.q: I have visited my grandmother last week.
accept: I visited my grandmother last week.
drills.why: last week 是明確的過去時間，用過去式。

drills.q: He didn't eat anything since this morning.
accept: He hasn't eaten anything since this morning.
He has not eaten anything since this morning.
drills.why: since this morning 是從早上到現在，用現在完成式。

steps.t: 主詞是「被做的那一方」：be + 過去分詞
steps.p: 藥不會自己給自己，是「被給」；房間是「被打掃」。

ex.en: The room is cleaned every day.
ex.zh: 這個房間每天有人打掃。

ex.en: The medicine was given at eight.

steps.t: 時態看 be 動詞
steps.p: 現在用 am／is／are，過去用 was／were；後面的過去分詞不變。

ex.en: The patients are checked every four hours.
ex.zh: 病人每四小時檢查一次。

ex.en: The window was broken.

steps.t: 要講是誰做的，加 by；不重要就不用講
steps.p: by + 做的人。

ex.en: This book was written by a nurse.
ex.zh: 這本書是一位護理師寫的。

ex.en: English is spoken here.

mistakes.good: The room is cleaned every day.
mistakes.why: 被動少了 be 動詞。
be 後面要用過去分詞 written。

drills.q: The floor ___ every morning.
drills.why: 地板是「被清潔」，用 is cleaned。

drills.q: The test results ___ yesterday.
drills.why: results 是複數，過去用 were sent。

drills.q: The medicine ___ (give) at eight last night.
drills.why: 藥是「被給」；last night 是過去，用 was given。

drills.q: This hospital was ___ in 1990.
drills.why: was 後面用過去分詞 built。

drills.q: English ___ (speak) in many countries.
drills.why: 英文「被說」，現在式用 is spoken。

drills.q: The door was close at ten.
accept: The door was closed at ten.
drills.why: was 後面要用過去分詞 closed。

drills.q: The patient is check every two hours.
accept: The patient is checked every two hours.
drills.why: is 後面要用過去分詞 checked。

steps.t: 用一句話說明「是哪一個」
steps.p: 把說明直接放在名詞後面。中文的說明放前面（幫我的那位護理師），英文放後面（the nurse who helped me）。

ex.en: The nurse who helped me is kind.
ex.zh: 幫我的那位護理師很親切。

ex.en: This is the book that I bought.

steps.t: 人用 who，東西用 which，that 兩種都可以
steps.p: 不確定的時候用 that 最安全。

ex.en: I have a friend who lives in Taipei.
ex.zh: 我有一個住台北的朋友。

ex.en: The medicine which I take is expensive.

steps.t: who 後面的動詞，要跟前面的名詞一致
steps.p: 前面的名詞是單數，動詞加 s；是複數就不加。

ex.en: The patient who has a fever is in Room 3.
ex.zh: 發燒的那位病人在三號房。

ex.en: The students who study hard pass the test.
ex.zh: 認真讀書的學生通過考試。

mistakes.bad: The man which called is my uncle.
mistakes.good: The man who called is my uncle.
mistakes.why: 說明人用 who 或 that。

mistakes.bad: I have a friend who live in Tainan.
mistakes.good: I have a friend who lives in Tainan.
mistakes.why: who 指的是 a friend（單數），動詞要加 s。

drills.q: The doctor ___ saw me was very kind.
drills.why: 說明人用 who。

drills.q: This is the medicine ___ I take every day.
drills.why: 說明事物用 that 或 which。

drills.q: I know a girl who ___ (speak) Japanese.
drills.why: who 指 a girl（單數），動詞加 s。

drills.q: The patient ___ came in last night has a fever.
drills.why: 說明人用 who。

drills.q: The book ___ is on the table is mine.（填 which 或 who）
drills.why: 說明事物用 which。

drills.q: The nurse which helped me was nice.
accept: The nurse who helped me was nice.
The nurse that helped me was nice.
drills.why: 說明人用 who 或 that。

drills.q: She has a brother who work in a bank.
accept: She has a brother who works in a bank.
drills.why: who 指 a brother（單數），動詞加 s。

head: 說明的對象
用哪個字
例子
rows: the bed that is near the window

steps.t: 把問句放進另一句裡，順序變回一般句子
steps.p: 直接問：Where is the bathroom? 放進去：Can you tell me where the bathroom is?

ex.en: Can you tell me where it hurts?
I don't know what his name is.
ex.zh: 我不知道他叫什麼名字。

steps.t: 不再用 do／does／did
steps.p: 直接問：When did he come? 放進去：Do you know when he came?（did 不見了，動詞自己變過去式）

ex.en: Do you know when he came?
ex.zh: 你知道他什麼時候來的嗎？

ex.en: Tell me what you ate.

steps.t: 沒有疑問詞的問句，用 if 或 whether
steps.p: 意思是「是不是、有沒有」。

ex.en: I don't know if he is here.
Can you tell me whether it is open?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我有沒有開嗎？

mistakes.bad: Can you tell me where is the pain?
mistakes.good: Can you tell me where the pain is?
mistakes.why: 間接問句裡主詞要在動詞前面。

mistakes.bad: I don't know what does he want.
mistakes.good: I don't know what he wants.
mistakes.why: 間接問句不用 does，動詞自己加 s。

drills.q: Do you know where ___?
drills.why: 間接問句用一般句子的順序：主詞 + 動詞。

drills.q: I don't know ___ she is coming.
drills.why: 沒有疑問詞的問句，用 if（是不是）。

drills.q: Can you tell me what time it ___ (be)?
drills.why: 間接問句：主詞 it 在前，動詞 is 在後。

drills.q: Tell me when ___.
drills.why: 間接問句不用 did，動詞自己變過去式。

drills.q: I don't know where he ___ (live).
drills.why: 不用 does，動詞自己加 s。

drills.q: Do you know what is her name?
accept: Do you know what her name is?
drills.why: 間接問句裡主詞 her name 要在 is 前面。

drills.q: Can you tell me where does he work?
accept: Can you tell me where he works?
drills.why: 間接問句不用 does，動詞自己加 s。

table.title: 直接問句和間接問句
head: 直接問句
間接問句
rows: Do you know where she is?
I don't know what he wants.
Can you tell me when it started?
I don't know if he is here.

steps.t: say (that) + 句子；tell + 人 + (that) + 句子
steps.p: say 後面不直接接人；tell 後面一定要有人。

ex.en: She said that she was tired.
He told me that he was hungry.

steps.t: 用 said／told 轉述時，按時間和語境決定要不要退移時態
steps.p: 需要退移時，am／is 用 was、are 用 were、will 用 would、can 用 could，現在式改成過去式。內容現在仍成立、仍相關，或事情還沒發生時，也可以保留原時態。

ex.en: He said he felt dizzy.
She said she would come.
ex.zh: 她說她會來。（will 退移成 would。）

ex.en: She said she will come tonight.
ex.zh: 她說她今晚會來。（現在還沒到今晚，可以保留 will。）

steps.t: 轉述當下的病人說法
steps.p: 交班常用 says、reports、denies（否認）、complains of（主訴）。

ex.en: The patient says he feels dizzy.
She denies any chest pain.

mistakes.bad: He said me that he was tired.
mistakes.good: He told me that he was tired.
mistakes.why: 後面有「人」要用 tell；say 後面不直接接人。

mistakes.bad: She told that she was busy.
mistakes.good: She said that she was busy.
mistakes.why: tell 後面要有人，沒有人就用 say。

drills.q: She ___ me that she was busy.
drills.why: 後面有 me（人），用 told。

drills.q: Yesterday he said that he ___ tired, but today he is fine.
drills.why: 他今天已經不累了。這裡描述的是他昨天說的當時狀態，用 was。

drills.q: Earlier she said she ___ (will) call me tonight. It is still afternoon.
drills.why: 用 would 是時態退移。現在還沒到今晚，保留提示的原形 will（原時態）也成立。

drills.q: The patient ___ of chest pain.
drills.why: 主訴某個症狀：complain of。

drills.q: Yesterday he ___ (tell) me that he was hungry.
drills.why: tell 的過去式是 told。

drills.q: She said me that she was sick.
accept: She told me that she was sick.
drills.why: 後面有 me，要用 told。

drills.q: He told that he was late.
accept: He said that he was late.
drills.why: tell 後面要有人，沒有人就用 said。

steps.t: as…as 一樣，not as…as 沒那麼
steps.p: as 和 as 中間放形容詞或副詞的原形。not as…as 等於「比較沒有……」，常用來說病情好轉。

ex.en: She is as tall as her mother.
My room is not as big as yours.

steps.t: too 太（不好），enough 夠
steps.p: too 放在形容詞前面，表示超過、不好；enough 放在形容詞後面、名詞前面。後面都可以接 to＋原形。

ex.en: The box is too heavy to lift.
Is the water warm enough?

steps.t: -ed 說人的感覺，-ing 說事情
steps.p: bored／boring、tired／tiring、interested／interesting、excited／exciting、worried／worrying：人覺得怎樣用 -ed，事情讓人怎樣用 -ing。

ex.en: I am tired after work.
The night shift is tiring.

mistakes.bad: He is enough old to drive.
mistakes.good: He is old enough to drive.
mistakes.why: enough 放在形容詞後面。

mistakes.bad: I am boring in this class.
mistakes.good: I am bored in this class.
mistakes.why: 說自己的感覺用 bored；I am boring 是「我這個人很無聊」。

drills.q: This bag is ___ heavy for me to carry.
drills.why: 太重而搬不動，用 too。

drills.q: Is the room ___?
drills.why: enough 放在形容詞後面。

drills.q: My brother is as ___ as my dad.（tall）
drills.why: as…as 中間用原形 tall。

drills.q: The movie was very ___. I fell asleep.
drills.why: 電影讓人無聊，用 boring。

drills.q: Today is not ___ hot as yesterday.（填一個字）
drills.why: not as…as／not so…as：沒有那麼……。as 比較常用，so 也對。

drills.q: I'm too tired to walking.
accept: I am too tired to walk.
drills.why: too…to 後面接原形 walk。

drills.q: She is interesting in music.
drills.why: 人有興趣用 interested，後面接 in。

steps.t: tell／ask／want＋人＋to＋原形
steps.p: 叫、請、要某人做某事：tell／ask／want／remind＋人＋to＋原形。否定在 to 前面加 not：told me not to run。

ex.en: She asked me to wait.
The nurse told him not to eat.
ex.zh: 護理師叫他不要吃東西。

steps.t: to 說目的；make／let＋人＋原形
steps.p: to＋原形放在句子後面表示「為了……」；make（叫人非做不可）、let（允許）後面接人再接原形，不加 to；help 後面接原形或 to＋原形都可以。

ex.en: I went out to buy lunch.
Let him sleep.

steps.t: remember to／-ing 和 used to
steps.p: remember／forget to＋原形是「記得／忘記要做」，接 -ing 是「記得／忘了做過」；stop to＋原形是停下來去做，stop＋-ing 是不再做。used to＋原形說以前的習慣，現在不再；問句和否定用 use to。

ex.en: I forgot to lock the door.
We used to live in Taichung.

mistakes.good: The doctor told me to rest.
mistakes.why: tell＋人＋to＋原形，to 不能少。

mistakes.bad: My mom made me to clean my room.
mistakes.good: My mom made me clean my room.
mistakes.why: make＋人＋原形，不加 to。

drills.q: The nurse told me ___ water.
drills.why: tell＋人＋to＋原形。

drills.q: My parents don't let me ___ late.
drills.why: let＋人＋原形。

drills.q: I went to the store ___ buy milk.（填一個字）
drills.why: to＋原形表示目的。

drills.q: Remember ___ your medicine after meals.
drills.why: 記得要去做：remember to＋原形。

drills.q: I ___ to live in Tainan, but now I live in Taipei.（填一個字）
drills.why: 以前住（現在不住）：used to。

drills.q: She made me to wait for an hour.
accept: She made me wait for an hour.
drills.why: make＋人＋原形，不加 to。

drills.q: Did you used to play the piano?
accept: Did you use to play the piano?
drills.why: 問句有 did，used 要變回 use。

table.title: 動詞句型
head: 句型
意思
例子
rows: The doctor told me to rest.
I went out to buy lunch.
make／let＋人＋原形（help 加不加 to 都可以）

steps.t: have／has been + 動詞 ing：從以前一直做到現在
steps.p: 動作從過去開始，到現在還在繼續，或剛剛才停。

ex.en: She has been coughing for a week.
I have been waiting for an hour.

steps.t: 常跟 for、since、How long 一起用
steps.p: for + 一段時間，since + 起點。

ex.en: How long have you been waiting?
It has been raining since morning.

steps.t: 和現在完成式的差別
steps.p: 強調「一直在做、可能還沒停」用進行式；強調「做完了、做了幾次」用現在完成式。know、like、have（擁有）這類狀態動詞不用進行式。

ex.en: I have been reading this book.
ex.zh: 我一直在讀這本書。（還沒讀完）

ex.en: I have read this book.
ex.zh: 我讀過這本書了。（讀完了）

mistakes.bad: I have been wait for an hour.
mistakes.good: I have been waiting for an hour.
mistakes.why: been 後面的動詞要加 ing。

mistakes.bad: I have been knowing him for years.
mistakes.good: I have known him for years.
mistakes.why: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式。

drills.q: She has been ___ since last night.
drills.why: has been 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: How long ___ you been living here?
drills.why: you 配 have。

drills.q: He ___ (wait) for two hours. He is still waiting.
drills.why: 等了兩小時、現在還在等，用 has been waiting。

drills.q: It ___ raining all day.
drills.why: it 配 has been。

drills.q: I have been ___ (study) English for three years.
drills.why: have been 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: They have been work here since 2020.
accept: They have been working here since 2020.
drills.why: been 後面的動詞要加 ing。

drills.q: She have been feeling tired lately.
accept: She has been feeling tired lately.
drills.why: she 配 has。

table.title: 現在完成進行式的三種句子
head: 句型
公式
例子
rows: Have／Has + 主詞 + been + 動詞 ing?

steps.t: had + 過去分詞：比過去更早
steps.p: 兩件過去的事，先發生的那一件用 had + 過去分詞。

ex.en: When I arrived, the bus had left.
ex.zh: 我到的時候公車已經開走了。

ex.en: He had taken the pill before he came.
ex.zh: 他來之前已經吃過藥了。

steps.t: 不管主詞是誰都用 had
steps.p: I had、she had、they had，都一樣。

ex.en: She had already eaten when I called.
ex.zh: 我打給她時她已經吃過了。

ex.en: They had never seen snow before.

steps.t: 順序已經很清楚時，兩件都用過去式也可以
steps.p: 有 before、after，或照發生順序一件一件說，就不一定要用。

ex.en: I ate before I left.
The class had started when I arrived.
ex.zh: 我到的時候已經開始上課了。

mistakes.bad: When I arrived, the train has left.
mistakes.good: When I arrived, the train had left.
mistakes.why: 比「我到」更早的事，用 had，不是 has。
had 後面用過去分詞 gone。

drills.q: When we got there, the movie ___.
drills.why: 比「我們到」更早，用 had started。

drills.q: He ___ never been to a hospital before that day.
drills.why: 那一天「之前」，用 had。

drills.q: She had already ___ (leave) when I called.
drills.why: had 後面用過去分詞 left。

drills.q: I was hungry because I ___ breakfast.
drills.why: 「沒吃早餐」比「餓」更早，用 hadn't eaten。

drills.q: When the nurse came, the patient ___ (already，take) the medicine.
drills.why: 比「護理師來」更早，用 had already taken。

drills.q: When I got home, my mother has cooked dinner.
accept: When I got home, my mother had cooked dinner.
drills.why: 比「我到家」更早，用 had。

drills.q: They had ate before the meeting.
accept: They had eaten before the meeting.
drills.why: had 後面用過去分詞 eaten。

table.title: 誰先誰後
head: 時間
時態
例子
rows: 過去完成式 had + 過去分詞

steps.t: 跟現在事實相反：If + 過去式，主要句 would + 原形
steps.p: 這裡用過去式不是在講過去，是表示「不是真的」。

ex.en: If I had more time, I would study more.
ex.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我會多讀一點。（其實沒時間）

ex.en: If she lived here, I would see her often.
ex.zh: 如果她住這裡，我就能常見到她。

steps.t: be 動詞常用 were
steps.p: 不管主詞是誰都常用 were。給建議最常說 If I were you, I would…

ex.en: If I were you, I would rest.
If he were here, he would help us.
ex.zh: 如果他在這裡，他會幫我們。

steps.t: 和第一類的差別
steps.p: 第一類：真的可能發生（If it rains, I will…）。第二類：想像的、不太可能（If I were rich, I would…）。

ex.en: If I win, I will call you.
ex.zh: 如果我贏了，我會打給你。（有可能）

ex.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
ex.zh: 如果我中樂透，我會買房子。（想像）

mistakes.bad: If I was you, I will rest.
mistakes.good: If I were you, I would rest.
mistakes.why: 想像的情況用 were 和 would。

mistakes.bad: If I would have money, I would buy it.
mistakes.good: If I had money, I would buy it.
mistakes.why: if 那一句用過去式，不用 would。

drills.q: If I ___ you, I would see a doctor.
drills.why: 想像的情況，be 動詞用 were。

drills.q: If she had a car, she ___ to work.
drills.why: 主要句用 would + 原形。

drills.q: If I ___ (have) more time, I would exercise.
drills.why: if 那一句用過去式。

drills.q: What ___ you do if you lost your phone?
drills.why: 想像的情況，主要句用 would。

drills.q: If he studied harder, he ___ (will) pass the test.
drills.why: 第二類假設的主要句用 would。

drills.q: If I were rich, I will travel around the world.
accept: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.
drills.why: 想像的情況，主要句用 would。

drills.q: If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
accept: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
drills.why: if 那一句用過去式 knew，不用 would。

steps.t: although／even though（雖然）+ 句子
steps.p: although 和 but 不能一起用，只能選一個。

ex.en: Although he is tired, he wants to walk.
ex.zh: 雖然他很累，他還是想走路。

ex.en: Even though it was raining, we went out.
ex.zh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

steps.t: despite／in spite of（儘管）+ 名詞或動詞 ing
steps.p: 後面不能接完整的句子。

ex.en: Despite the pain, she smiled.
In spite of feeling tired, he kept working.
ex.zh: 儘管覺得累，他還是繼續工作。

steps.t: however 放第二句開頭；while／whereas 對比兩件事
steps.p: however（然而）前面是句號，後面加逗號。

ex.en: He feels better. However, he still has a fever.
ex.zh: 他好一點了，但還在發燒。

ex.en: My brother likes coffee, while I like tea.
ex.zh: 我哥喜歡咖啡，而我喜歡茶。

mistakes.bad: Although he is sick, but he goes to work.
mistakes.good: Although he is sick, he goes to work.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 只能用一個。

mistakes.bad: Despite he was tired, he kept working.
mistakes.good: Although he was tired, he kept working.
mistakes.why: despite 後面不能接句子；接句子用 although。

drills.q: ___ it was cold, he didn't wear a coat.
drills.why: 後面是句子，用 Although。

drills.q: ___ the rain, we went for a walk.
drills.why: 後面是名詞 the rain，用 Despite。

drills.q: She was tired. ___, she finished her work.（然而，一個字）
drills.why: 第二句開頭的「然而」用 However。

drills.q: In spite of ___ sick, she went to class.
drills.why: in spite of 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: ___ though he studied hard, he failed the test.（填一個字）
drills.why: even though 是「雖然」。

drills.q: Although she was tired, but she kept walking.
accept: Although she was tired, she kept walking.
She was tired, but she kept walking.
drills.why: although 和 but 只能留一個。

drills.q: Despite it rained, they played outside.
accept: Although it rained, they played outside.
Even though it rained, they played outside.
Despite the rain, they played outside.
drills.why: despite 後面不能接句子：改用 although，或改成名詞 the rain。

table.title: 後面接什麼
head: 字
後面接
例子
rows: 另一句（前面句號、後面逗號）

steps.t: because of／due to（由於）+ 名詞；because + 句子
steps.p: 後面是名詞還是句子，決定用哪一個。

ex.en: The flight was late because of the rain.
The surgery was delayed due to a fever.

steps.t: therefore／as a result（因此）放第二句開頭
steps.p: 前面是句號，後面加逗號。

ex.en: He did not eat. Therefore, he felt weak.
ex.zh: 他沒吃東西，因此覺得虛弱。

ex.en: She studied hard. As a result, she passed.

steps.t: 原因 + cause／lead to／result in + 結果
steps.p: 這幾個動詞後面接「結果」。

ex.en: Smoking can cause lung cancer.
Poor sleep can lead to headaches.

mistakes.bad: He was late because of he missed the bus.
mistakes.good: He was late because he missed the bus.
mistakes.why: 後面是句子，用 because；because of 後面接名詞。

mistakes.bad: He was sick, therefore he stayed home.
mistakes.good: He was sick. Therefore, he stayed home.
mistakes.why: therefore 不是連接詞：前面用句號，後面加逗號。

drills.q: The game was canceled ___ the rain.
drills.why: 後面是名詞 the rain，用 because of。

drills.q: He was tired ___ he worked all night.
drills.why: 後面是句子，用 because。

drills.q: She didn't sleep well. ___, she felt tired.（因此，一個字）
drills.why: 第二句開頭的「因此」用 Therefore。

drills.q: Too much sugar can lead ___ health problems.
drills.why: lead to + 結果。

drills.q: The delay was ___ to bad weather.（由於，一個字）
drills.why: due to + 名詞。

drills.q: I stayed home because of I was sick.
accept: I stayed home because I was sick.
drills.why: 後面是句子，用 because。

drills.q: The road was closed due to it snowed.
accept: The road was closed due to snow.
The road was closed due to the snow.
The road was closed because it snowed.
The road was closed because of the snow.
The road was closed because of snow.
drills.why: due to 後面接名詞；要接句子就用 because。

steps.t: 助動詞 + be + 過去分詞
steps.p: can be done、should be given、must be checked、will be discharged。醫囑和衛教很常這樣說。

ex.en: This drug should be given with food.
ex.zh: 這個藥應該跟食物一起吃。

ex.en: The wound must be kept dry.

steps.t: be 永遠是原形 be
steps.p: 助動詞後面接原形，所以不會變成 is／are／was。

ex.en: The test can be done today.
He will be discharged tomorrow.

steps.t: 否定加在助動詞後面
steps.p: 例如 should not be、must not be、cannot be。

ex.en: This medicine should not be taken with milk.
The form must not be changed.

mistakes.bad: The medicine should give at eight.
mistakes.good: The medicine should be given at eight.
mistakes.why: 藥是「被給」，要用 be + 過去分詞。
助動詞後面用原形 be。

drills.q: The wound should ___ every day.
drills.why: 傷口是「被清潔」，助動詞後面用 be + 過去分詞。

drills.q: This form must be ___ by the patient.
drills.why: be 後面用過去分詞 signed。

drills.q: The results will ___ (send) tomorrow.
drills.why: 結果是「被寄出」，用 will be sent。

drills.q: This medicine ___ be taken with food.
drills.why: 助動詞 should 直接接 be。

drills.q: The door must ___ (keep) closed.
drills.why: 門是「被保持」關著，用 must be kept。

drills.q: The room must cleaned today.
accept: The room must be cleaned today.
drills.why: 少了 be。

drills.q: He will is discharged tomorrow.
drills.why: will 後面用原形 be。

steps.t: that + 一整句，當「想、覺得、希望」的內容
steps.p: that 後面是完整的句子（主詞 + 動詞）。

ex.en: I think that he is right.
I hope that you feel better soon.

steps.t: 口語常常省略 that
steps.p: 意思完全一樣。

ex.en: I think he is right.
I'm sure she will come.

steps.t: It is + 形容詞 + that…
steps.p: It is important that…（…很重要）、It is possible that…（有可能…）。

ex.en: It is important that you take the antibiotics on time.
It is possible that he forgot.

mistakes.bad: I think that is he right.
mistakes.good: I think that he is right.
mistakes.why: that 後面是一般句子的順序：主詞 + 動詞。

mistakes.bad: I hope you to get well.
mistakes.why: hope 後面接完整句子，不是 you to…。

drills.q: I think ___ she is a good nurse.
drills.why: I think that + 句子。

drills.q: It is important ___ you drink enough water.
drills.why: It is important that + 句子。

drills.q: I hope that he ___ (be) OK.
drills.why: that 後面是完整句子；he 配 is。

drills.q: I'm sure ___.
drills.why: 後面是一般句子的順序。

drills.q: It is possible ___ she forgot.（填一個字）
drills.why: It is possible that + 句子。

drills.q: I think that is it too expensive.
accept: I think that it is too expensive.
I think it is too expensive.
drills.why: that 後面用一般句子的順序：it is。

drills.q: I hope you to feel better soon.
accept: I hope you feel better soon.
I hope that you feel better soon.
drills.why: hope 後面接完整句子。

table.title: 常用的開頭
head: 開頭
例子
rows: I think (that) it is too late.
It is important that you rest.
It is possible that it is an allergy.

steps.t: 把 who is／which is 拿掉，句子變短
steps.p: the patient who is lying in bed 3 可以縮成 the patient lying in bed 3。

ex.en: The patient lying in bed 3 needs help.
ex.zh: 躺在三床的病人需要幫忙。

ex.en: The woman talking to the doctor is my mother.
ex.zh: 在跟醫師講話的那位女士是我媽媽。

steps.t: 自己在做的（主動）用動詞 ing
steps.p: 名詞自己在做這個動作。

ex.en: The man sitting by the window is my uncle.
ex.zh: 坐在窗邊的男人是我叔叔。

ex.en: Students living far away take the bus.

steps.t: 被做的（被動）用過去分詞
steps.p: 名詞是被做的那一方。

ex.en: The medicine given at eight was aspirin.
ex.zh: 八點給的藥是阿斯匹靈。

ex.en: The book written by her is popular.
ex.zh: 她寫的那本書很受歡迎。

mistakes.bad: The man sit over there is my teacher.
mistakes.good: The man sitting over there is my teacher.
mistakes.why: 說明名詞要用 sitting，不能用原形。

mistakes.bad: The letter writing by him was long.
mistakes.good: The letter written by him was long.
mistakes.why: 信是「被寫」，用過去分詞 written。

drills.q: The girl ___ next to me is my sister.
drills.why: 女孩自己坐著（主動），用 sitting。

drills.q: The medicine ___ by the doctor is expensive.
drills.why: 藥是「被開立」，用過去分詞。

drills.q: The patients ___ (wait) outside are tired.
drills.why: 病人自己在等（主動），用 waiting。

drills.q: The window ___ yesterday has been fixed.
drills.why: 窗戶是「被打破」，用過去分詞 broken。

drills.q: The report ___ (write) last week was very long.
drills.why: 報告是「被寫」，用過去分詞 written。

drills.q: The nurse stand at the door is new.
accept: The nurse standing at the door is new.
drills.why: 護理師自己站著，用 standing。

drills.q: The food cooking by my mother is delicious.
accept: The food cooked by my mother is delicious.
drills.why: 食物是「被煮」，用過去分詞 cooked。

table.title: 完整的說法和縮短的說法
head: 完整的關係子句
縮短後
rows: the nurse who is standing there
the patients who are waiting outside
the drug that was given at eight
the tests that were done yesterday

steps.t: 上升、下降、不變
steps.p: 上升：increase、rise、go up；下降：decrease、drop、fall、go down；不變：remain、stay the same。

ex.en: His temperature rose last night.
The number of patients decreased.

steps.t: from A to B（從多少到多少）、by（變了多少）
steps.p: from 150 to 120 是從 150 到 120；by 30 是變了 30。

ex.en: His blood pressure dropped from 150 to 120.
The price increased by ten dollars.

steps.t: 加副詞說變化的大小和快慢
steps.p: slightly 稍微、gradually 逐漸、sharply 急遽、steadily 穩定地。

ex.en: Her weight increased slightly.
The number fell sharply in May.

mistakes.why: rise 的過去式是 rose。
從多少到多少用 from…to…。

drills.q: The temperature ___ from 36 to 39.
drills.why: 36 到 39 是上升，用 rose。

drills.q: Sales increased ___ 20 percent.
drills.why: 變化的幅度用 by。

drills.q: His heart rate fell ___ 110 to 80.（填一個字）
drills.why: 從多少到多少：from…to…。

drills.q: The number of nurses ___ the same last year.
drills.why: 沒變用 remained the same。

drills.q: Prices ___ (go) up last month.
drills.why: go 的過去式是 went。

drills.q: The number of students increase last year.
accept: The number of students increased last year.
drills.why: last year 是過去，用 increased。

drills.q: Her blood sugar falled to 60.
drills.why: fall 的過去式是 fell。

steps.t: 第一步：先說意見
steps.p: I think、In my opinion、I believe。In my opinion 後面加逗號，而且不要再加 I think。

ex.en: In my opinion, nurses need good English.
ex.zh: 我認為護理師需要好的英文。

ex.en: I believe exercise is important.

steps.t: 第二步：說理由，再舉例
steps.p: 理由：because、The main reason is that…；例子：For example、For instance。

ex.en: The main reason is that they talk to many patients.
ex.zh: 主要原因是他們要跟很多病人說話。

ex.en: For example, I study ten minutes every day.

steps.t: 同意、不同意和收尾
steps.p: I agree that…／I do not agree that…（不能說 I am agree）；收尾用 That is why…

ex.en: I agree that sleep is important.
That is why I want to be a nurse.
ex.zh: 這就是我想當護理師的原因。

mistakes.why: agree 是動詞，前面不加 am。

mistakes.bad: In my opinion, I think it is good.
mistakes.good: In my opinion, it is good.
mistakes.why: In my opinion 和 I think 意思重複，用一個就好。

drills.q: ___ my opinion, health is more important than money.
drills.why: 固定說法是 In my opinion。

drills.q: I ___ that children should exercise every day.
drills.why: agree 是動詞，直接用。

drills.q: The main reason ___ that it saves time.（填一個字）
drills.why: 固定說法：The main reason is that…。

drills.q: ___, I walk to school every day.
drills.why: 舉例用 For example。

drills.q: I was sick. That is ___ I stayed home.（填一個字）
drills.why: That is why… 是「這就是為什麼…」。

drills.q: I am not agree with this idea.
accept: I do not agree with this idea.
I don't agree with this idea.
drills.why: agree 是動詞，否定用 do not agree。

drills.q: In my opinion, I think nurses work hard.
accept: In my opinion, nurses work hard.
drills.why: In my opinion 和 I think 只留一個。

table.title: 把回答講長的四步
head: 步驟
可以用的話
rows: I agree that…／I do not agree that…

steps.t: 泛指的時候，不可數名詞和複數名詞不加冠詞
steps.p: 講「所有的水」「一般的護理師」，不是特定的哪一個。

ex.en: Water is important.
Nurses work hard.

steps.t: 三餐、語言、運動、多數疾病不加；小毛病要加 a
steps.p: have breakfast、speak English、play basketball、have diabetes；但 a cold、a fever、a headache 要加 a。

ex.en: I have breakfast at seven.
He has diabetes and a cold.

steps.t: 唯一的東西、最高級加 the；固定說法整組背
steps.p: go to bed、go to school、at home、at work 不加；「住院」美式說 in the hospital。

ex.en: She is the best nurse here.
ex.zh: 她是這裡最好的護理師。

ex.en: He is in the hospital.

mistakes.why: 運動前面不加 the。
headache 前面要加 a。

drills.q: I usually have ___ breakfast at seven.
drills.why: 三餐前面不加冠詞。

drills.q: He has ___ fever.
drills.why: fever 前面要加 a。

drills.q: This is ___ best hospital in the city.（填一個字）
drills.why: 最高級前面加 the。

drills.q: In general, ___ doctors need many years of training.
drills.why: 泛指所有醫師，複數名詞不加冠詞。

drills.q: I have ___ headache.（填一個字）
drills.why: headache 前面要加 a。

drills.q: My father has a diabetes.
drills.why: 多數疾病名稱前面不加冠詞。

drills.q: We play the soccer after school.
drills.why: 運動前面不加 the。

steps.t: 有些字習慣一起用，要整組背
steps.p: take medicine（不說 eat medicine）、make an appointment、have surgery、take a shower、do homework、make a mistake。

ex.en: I need to make an appointment.
He takes medicine every morning.

steps.t: 片語動詞：動詞 + 小字，意思要整組記
steps.p: pass out 昏倒、throw up 嘔吐、look after 照顧、get over 康復、come down with 染上。

ex.en: He passed out in the bathroom.
She threw up twice last night.

steps.t: 受詞放哪裡
steps.p: put on your mask 和 put your mask on 都可以；受詞是 it／them 時一定放中間：put it on。

ex.en: Please take off your shoes.
Take them off, please.

mistakes.why: 吃藥的動詞用 take。
受詞是 it 時要放在中間。

drills.q: I need to ___ an appointment with the doctor.
drills.why: 預約是 make an appointment。

drills.q: She ___ a cold last week.
drills.why: 染上感冒是 come down with a cold。

drills.q: He felt dizzy and passed ___.（填一個字）
drills.why: 昏倒是 pass out。

drills.q: Please ___ your coat. It is cold outside.
drills.why: 外面冷，要「穿上」外套：put on。

drills.q: Who will look ___ the children?（填一個字）
drills.why: 照顧是 look after。

drills.q: She did a mistake on the test.
accept: She made a mistake on the test.
drills.why: 犯錯是 make a mistake。

drills.q: Your shoes are dirty. Please take off them.
accept: Your shoes are dirty. Please take them off.
drills.why: 受詞是 them 時要放在中間。

steps.t: 故事的主線用過去式，背景用過去進行式
steps.p: 發生了什麼事用過去式；那時候正在進行的畫面用 was／were + 動詞 ing。

ex.en: It was raining when I left the hospital.
ex.zh: 我離開醫院的時候在下雨。

ex.en: I was walking home when I saw an accident.
ex.zh: 我走路回家時看到一場車禍。

steps.t: 更早發生的事用過去完成式
steps.p: had + 過去分詞，表示「在那之前就已經…」。

ex.en: When I got to the ward, the nurse had already taken his blood pressure.
ex.zh: 我到病房時，護理師已經量過他的血壓了。

ex.en: I realized I had left my phone at home.
ex.zh: 我發現我把手機忘在家裡了。

steps.t: 以前的習慣（現在不這樣了）：used to + 原形
steps.p: 否定是 didn't use to，問句是 Did you use to…?

ex.en: I used to live in Tainan.
She used to smoke, but she quit.

mistakes.bad: I use to play soccer when I was a child.
mistakes.good: I used to play soccer when I was a child.
mistakes.why: 以前的習慣用 used to，有 d。

mistakes.bad: I didn't used to like coffee.
mistakes.good: I didn't use to like coffee.
mistakes.why: didn't 後面用原形 use。

drills.q: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
drills.why: 電話響的時候「正在」看，用過去進行式。

drills.q: When we arrived, the meeting ___ already ___.
drills.why: 比「我們到」更早，用 had started。

drills.q: She ___ (use) to live in Japan, but now she lives in Taiwan.
drills.why: 以前的習慣：used to。

drills.q: He was tired because he ___ all night.
drills.why: 「工作一整晚」比「累」更早，用 had worked。

drills.q: While I ___ (cook), my brother was doing his homework.
drills.instruction: 請用過去進行式，描述兩件事在當時同時進行。
drills.why: 這題要描述當時仍在進行的動作。I 搭配 was cooking。

drills.q: I use to play the piano when I was young.
accept: I used to play the piano when I was young.
drills.why: 以前的習慣用 used to。

drills.q: When I got to the station, the train already left.
accept: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
drills.why: 比「我到車站」更早，用 had left。

table.title: 講故事用的四種說法
head: 作用
時態
例子
rows: I used to walk to school.

steps.t: 已經約好的安排：現在進行式
steps.p: 時間、對象都確定了，用 am／is／are + 動詞 ing 講未來。

ex.en: I'm meeting Dr. Lin tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要跟林醫師見面。

ex.en: We are flying to Tokyo on Friday.

steps.t: 未來某個時間點正在做：will be + 動詞 ing
steps.p: 想像那個時間點的畫面。

ex.en: This time tomorrow, I'll be working the night shift.
ex.zh: 明天這個時候我會在上夜班。

ex.en: At ten, she will be having surgery.
ex.zh: 十點的時候她正在開刀。

steps.t: 到未來某個時間之前會完成：will have + 過去分詞
steps.p: 常配 by（在…之前）、by the time（等到…的時候）；by the time 後面用現在式。

ex.en: By June, I'll have finished this book.
ex.zh: 六月前我會讀完這本書。

ex.en: By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
ex.zh: 等你到的時候，我已經煮好晚餐了。

mistakes.bad: By the time he will arrive, we will have left.
mistakes.good: By the time he arrives, we will have left.
mistakes.why: by the time 後面用現在式。

mistakes.bad: I will have finish it by Friday.
mistakes.good: I will have finished it by Friday.
mistakes.why: will have 後面用過去分詞。

drills.q: This time next week, I ___ on the beach.
drills.why: 未來那個時間點「正在」躺著，用 will be + 動詞 ing。

drills.q: By this time next year, she ___ from nursing school.
drills.why: 到那時「已經」畢業，用 will have + 過去分詞。

drills.q: By the time you ___ (arrive), I will have left.
drills.why: by the time 後面用現在式；主詞是 you，所以就是原形 arrive。

drills.q: I ___ my dentist at three tomorrow. I made the appointment last week.
drills.why: 已經約好的安排，用現在進行式。

drills.q: At eight tonight, I will be ___ (study).
drills.why: will be 後面接動詞 ing。

drills.q: By 2030, I will have work as a nurse for a year.
accept: By 2030, I will have worked as a nurse for a year.
drills.why: will have 後面用過去分詞 worked。

drills.q: By the time she will come, we will have finished.
accept: By the time she comes, we will have finished.
drills.why: by the time 後面用現在式 comes。

table.title: 三種講未來的說法
head: 說法
公式
例子
rows: I'm seeing the dentist on Monday.

steps.t: 推測現在：must be、might be、can't be
steps.p: 很確定是：must be；有可能：might／may／could be；確定不是：can't be。

ex.en: He must be tired. He worked a twelve-hour shift.
ex.zh: 他一定很累，他上了十二小時的班。

ex.en: She might be at home.

steps.t: 推測過去：must／might／can't + have + 過去分詞
steps.p: 看到線索，推測之前發生了什麼。

ex.en: He must have forgotten.
She can't have seen us.

steps.t: 這是推論，不是事實
steps.p: 有把握用 must，沒把握用 might。「一定不是」用 can't，不用 mustn't。

ex.en: It might rain later.
That can't be true.

mistakes.good: He must have forgotten his keys.
mistakes.why: 推測過去用 must have + 過去分詞。

mistakes.bad: She mustn't be at home. The lights are off.
mistakes.good: She can't be at home. The lights are off.
mistakes.why: 推測「一定不在」用 can't。

drills.q: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
drills.why: 燈沒開，推測「一定不在」，用 can't。

drills.q: He isn't answering. He ___ be sleeping.
drills.why: 不確定，「可能」在睡，用 might。

drills.q: She looks pale. She must ___ (be) sick.
drills.why: must 後面用原形 be。

drills.q: The ground is wet. It ___ last night.
drills.why: 推測過去發生的事：must have + 過去分詞。

drills.q: I can't find my keys. I might have ___ (leave) them at work.
drills.why: might have 後面用過去分詞 left。

drills.q: He must has missed the bus.
accept: He must have missed the bus.
drills.why: must 後面用原形 have。

drills.q: She can't have saw the message.
accept: She can't have seen the message.
She cannot have seen the message.
drills.why: have 後面用過去分詞 seen。

steps.t: 跟過去事實相反：If + had + 過去分詞，主要句 would have + 過去分詞
steps.p: 事情已經發生、來不及改了，只是在想「如果當初…」。

ex.en: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have been late.
ex.zh: 如果我早點出門，就不會遲到了。（事實：遲到了）

ex.en: If she had studied, she would have passed.
ex.zh: 如果她有讀書，就會過了。

steps.t: 主要句也可以用 could have、might have
steps.p: could have 是「本來可以」，might have 是「也許會」。

ex.en: If he had called, I could have helped him.
ex.zh: 如果他有打來，我本來可以幫他。

ex.en: If we had hurried, we might have caught the bus.
ex.zh: 如果我們快一點，也許趕得上公車。

steps.t: 三類假設放在一起看
steps.p: 第一類講未來可能；第二類講現在的想像；第三類講過去來不及的事。

ex.en: If he had seen a doctor earlier, the wound wouldn't have gotten infected.
ex.zh: 如果他早點看醫師，傷口就不會感染了。

ex.en: If I had known, I would have told you.
ex.zh: 如果我早知道，我就會告訴你了。

mistakes.bad: If I would have known, I would have told you.
mistakes.good: If I had known, I would have told you.
mistakes.why: if 那一句用 had + 過去分詞，不用 would have。

mistakes.bad: If she had studied, she would pass the test last week.
mistakes.good: If she had studied, she would have passed the test last week.
mistakes.why: 講過去的結果用 would have + 過去分詞。（結果在現在的話，例如 If she had studied, she would be a nurse now，是另一種「混合假設」，之後再學。）

drills.q: If I ___ earlier, I would have caught the train.
drills.why: 跟過去事實相反，if 那一句用 had + 過去分詞。

drills.q: If she had asked me, I ___ her.
drills.why: 主要句用 would have + 過去分詞。

drills.q: If he had taken the medicine, he would have ___ (feel) better.
drills.why: would have 後面用過去分詞 felt。

drills.q: If we ___ the map, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
drills.why: if 那一句用 had + 過去分詞。

drills.q: If I had ___ (know) about the test, I would have studied.
drills.why: had 後面用過去分詞 known。

drills.q: If I had saw him, I would have said hello.
accept: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
drills.why: had 後面用過去分詞 seen。

drills.q: If you would have told me, I would have come.
accept: If you had told me, I would have come.
drills.why: if 那一句用 had + 過去分詞。

steps.t: 對現在的願望（事實不是這樣）：wish + 過去式
steps.p: 用過去式表示「不是真的」。be 動詞常用 were。

ex.en: I wish I had more time.
ex.zh: 真希望我有更多時間。（其實沒有）

ex.en: I wish I were taller.

steps.t: 對過去的遺憾：wish + had + 過去分詞
steps.p: if only 的用法跟 wish 一樣，語氣更強。

ex.en: I wish I had studied harder.
If only I had listened to her.
ex.zh: 要是我當初聽她的就好了。

steps.t: should have／shouldn't have + 過去分詞
steps.p: 當初應該做卻沒做／當初不該做卻做了。

ex.en: I should have called you.
I shouldn't have eaten so much.

mistakes.bad: I wish I have a car.
mistakes.good: I wish I had a car.
mistakes.why: 對現在的願望，wish 後面用過去式。

mistakes.bad: I should have went to bed earlier.
mistakes.good: I should have gone to bed earlier.
mistakes.why: should have 後面用過去分詞 gone。

drills.q: I wish I ___ speak English fluently.
drills.why: wish 後面用過去的形式 could。

drills.q: I wish I ___ harder last year.
drills.why: 對過去的遺憾，用 had + 過去分詞。

drills.q: I feel sick. I shouldn't have ___ (eat) so much.
drills.why: shouldn't have 後面用過去分詞 eaten。

drills.q: If only I ___ more time now.
drills.why: 對現在的願望，用過去式 had。

drills.q: You should have ___ (tell) me earlier.
drills.why: should have 後面用過去分詞 told。

drills.q: I wish I am taller.
drills.why: wish 後面用過去式；be 動詞常用 were。

drills.q: He should have took the medicine.
accept: He should have taken the medicine.
drills.why: should have 後面用過去分詞 taken。

table.title: 願望和遺憾
head: 想說什麼
公式
例子
rows: I wish I knew the answer.

steps.t: 補充說明，前後加逗號
steps.p: 這種子句只是多給一點資訊，拿掉之後句子還是完整。

ex.en: My sister, who is a nurse, lives in Taipei.
ex.zh: 我姊姊住台北，她是護理師。

ex.en: Taipei 101, which is very tall, is in Taipei.
ex.zh: 台北 101 在台北，它非常高。

steps.t: 人用 who、事物用 which、所有格用 whose、地點用 where
steps.p: 這種加逗號的子句不能用 that。

ex.en: Dr. Lin, whose office is on the third floor, is very kind.
ex.zh: 林醫師人很好，他的辦公室在三樓。

ex.en: Tainan, where I grew up, has great food.
ex.zh: 台南是我長大的地方，東西很好吃。

steps.t: which 也可以指前面整件事
steps.p: 逗號 + which，說明前面那件事造成什麼結果。

ex.en: He was late, which made the doctor angry.
ex.zh: 他遲到了，這讓醫師很生氣。

ex.en: She passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 她通過考試了，這讓大家很驚訝。

mistakes.bad: My mother, that is a teacher, is 50.
mistakes.good: My mother, who is a teacher, is 50.
mistakes.why: 加逗號的補充說明不能用 that。

mistakes.bad: He didn't come, what made us worried.
mistakes.good: He didn't come, which made us worried.
mistakes.why: 指前面整件事用 which。

drills.q: My father, ___ is a doctor, works in Taichung.
drills.why: 補充說明人，用 who；加逗號的子句不能用 that。

drills.q: This book, ___ I bought last week, is very good.
drills.why: 補充說明事物，用 which。

drills.q: Kaohsiung, ___ I was born, is a big city.（填一個字）
drills.why: 補充說明地點，用 where。

drills.q: She didn't call, ___ made me worried.
drills.why: 指前面整件事，用 which。

drills.q: Mr. Wang, ___ son is my classmate, is a nurse.（填一個字）
drills.why: 「他的兒子」是所有格，用 whose。

drills.q: My brother, that lives in Japan, is a nurse.
accept: My brother, who lives in Japan, is a nurse.
drills.why: 加逗號的補充說明不能用 that，人用 who。

drills.q: He failed the test, what surprised us.
accept: He failed the test, which surprised us.
drills.why: 指前面整件事用 which。
